A college student council surveyed attendees of four different campus events, asking each participant to choose one event they enjoyed most. Each survey response was received either in person or via a web form. The table below shows the distribution of preferences, in percent, by response method. The total number of web responses was three times the number of in-person responses.

|  | In person | Web form |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Open mic night | $40%$ | $30%$ |
| Outdoor movie | $25%$ | $20%$ |
| Game tournament | $20%$ | $25%$ |
| Art fair | $15%$ | $25%$ |
| **Total** | **$100%$** | **$100%$** |

If a student who preferred the game tournament is selected at random, what is the probability that the student responded using the web form?

{{field-1}}.
